questions.question: Explain why we must balance a chemical equation before doing any stoichiometric calculations.
questions.expected_answer: To obey the Law of Conservation of Mass and establish the correct molar ratio in which substances react and form.

questions.question: When converting from moles of one substance to moles of another, what piece of information from the balanced equation do you use?
questions.expected_answer: The coefficients (the large numbers in front of the formulas) which provide the molar ratio.

questions.question: Why is it important to show explicit substitution into formulas like n = m/M in an exam?
questions.expected_answer: Because the mark sheet specifically awards marks for showing the correct values substituted into the correct formula, not just for the final answer.
